item.title: Powell signals openness to a September cut
item.description: Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell told reporters on Wednesday that policymakers are increasingly open to lowering interest rates at their next meeting, citing cooling labor market data.

item.title: Shutdown talks collapse
item.description: Negotiations between congressional leaders and the White House broke down late Tuesday, raising the odds of a government shutdown at the end of the month.
